entries.en: Pfff... Talkin' out your ass.
You call this place deserted? This look deserted to you?
entries.ro: Locul ăsta ți se pare pustiu? Serios?

entries.en: Could cut off everything from here, but I can't get in. Locked down.
entries.ro: Aș putea tăia totul de aici, dar nu pot intra. E blocat.

entries.en: I'm not, I'm tellin' you! Think everybody just packed up and set out?
entries.ro: Nu, nu, îți zic! Crezi că toți și-au strâns catrafusele și au plecat?

entries.en: They're rolling in. In my Thorn! You see 'er?
entries.ro: Vin. În Thorn-ul meu! O vezi?

entries.en: I've been made.
Let's take 'em by surprise.
Fuck.
That might've been the cherry on top.
Let's pack it in.
I'll be inside. Holler when you see them.
entries.ro: Eu mă duc înăuntru. Strigă când îi vezi.

entries.en: Corpos shoved the whole thing under the rug. Biz as usual.
entries.ro: Corpoii au măturat totul sub covor. Ca de obicei.

entries.en: Riiiiight.
So who turned it on?
Maybe from up top somehow, I could...?
entries.ro: Poate de sus cumva, aș putea...?

entries.en: Really, really hard to miss.
Let's try to do this quietly. If anything happens, I'll start picking them off. Sound good?
entries.ro: Hai s-o facem liniștit. Dacă se complică, încep să-i trag pe rând. Ok?

entries.en: Sounds great.
Grab the car shard. The driver has it.
entries.ro: Ia shard-ul mașinii. Șoferul îl are.

entries.en: Or it's a trap. Look around. Nooks and crannies.
entries.ro: Sau e o capcană. Uită-te în jur. Colțuri și crăpături.

entries.en: Worth a try...
Get good and ready.
The show starts – now!
Covering you.
Grab the car shard. The driver has it.
entries.ro: Ia shard-ul mașinii. Șoferul îl are.

entries.en: Look for the girl with the mohawk.
Look for the girl with the mohawk.
Colorful bunch.
Colorful bunch.
Probably just some squatters...
We have to take out the brutes by the car. One for you, one for me.
entries.ro: Trebuie să-i eliminăm pe brutele de lângă mașină. Unu-i al tău, unu-i al meu.

entries.en: The car! Run! I'll drop this one.
entries.ro: Mașina! Fugi! Pe ăsta îl dobor eu.

entries.en: Got someone pokin' around this transformer. Looks skilled.
entries.ro: Am pe cineva care umblă pe lângă transformator. Pare priceput.

entries.en: Kind of. Could also be bored squatters.
entries.ro: Cam da. Ar putea fi și ocupanți ilegali plictisiți.

entries.en: [Turn on power]
Where's that son-of-a-bitch Boz?
We have to pick all of them off now.
entries.ro: Trebuie să-i eliminăm pe toți acum.

entries.en: Fuck, V. Turn on the goddamn power!
Let there be light.
You – wait for 'em here.
